text:
alex: Quick FYI — Enterprise Canvas (CanvasCorp) has a staged launch next Friday, heavy load test 13:00-15:00 UTC. They signed SLA >99.9% for token latency. I want to surface risk and request extra coverage during the load window.

maria: I can pair for the 12:30–16:00 UTC window. happy to take handoff at 11:30 so we can dry-run the scale tests. @alex please drop checklist. :thumbsup:

jordan: Heads-up — I’m PTO that day morning but can be on call from 14:00–18:00 UTC if needed. Won't be primary.

sam: I’m on the rotation for Friday morning but can swap with @maria so she covers the load window. @oncall-rotation confirm?

oncall-rotation: Current rota: sam (00:00–12:00 UTC), alex (12:00–18:00 UTC), jordan (18:00–00:00 UTC). Swap request noted — to swap sam <-> maria for 12:00–16:00 please file the swap in #eng-oncall-schedule with the two approvals.

alex: Filing now. Handoff notes (quick):
- Primary customer: CanvasCorp (VIP). Contact: ops@canvascorp.com -> pagerduty escalation 2.
- Expected peak: ~9k QPS (short bursts), average sustained ~2.5k QPS.
- Known risk: model shard OOM on long contexts (>=8k tokens) — fallback to quantized-2 when mem pressure rises.
- Playbook snippets:
```
# quick checks pre-load
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide
kubectl top pods -n inference | sort -r -k3
# tailing logs for token generator
tail -n 200 /var/log/inference/generator.log
```

maria: copying the runbook into the thread: /runbooks/canvas-launch — includes alert thresholds and rollback steps. Also set trace sampling to 100% for the load window.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary -> prod at 2026-03-20T22:00:00Z (today). Tags: canvas-launch/v1.2.0. Expected rollout 30m.

alex: Note: try to avoid cluster-wide scale-up during the peak — prefer model routing to dedicated reserved pool (dedicated-canvas) to keep latency stable. If autoscaler triggers >20% more GPUs, consider throttling batch size.

sam: Done — I posted the swap in #eng-oncall-schedule and @maria approved. I'll sign out of 12:00–16:00 on Friday. :white_check_mark:

jordan: pinging infra for burst capacity validation — @infra-team can you validate capacity for reserved-canvas pool?

maria: I'll take primary during the load test and stand by 11:30 for handoff. If anything goes sideways, page me first then escalate to alex/jordan.

alex: Thanks everyone. Final ask: whoever is primary during the load test, please add a short post-run note (latency percentiles, any fallbacks triggered) to the CanvasCorp runbook after the window.

deploy-bot: Canary started 22:00 UTC, 6/10 hosts -> 22:18 UTC all canary hosts healthy.

alex: noted — will follow up with results. :ok_hand:
